title: Verify mastery: Verify host-platform lifecycle compatibility

Verified by `tests/zc_platform_installers.rs`: zero_config_plan, read_installers, zc_platform_installers_share_zero_config_plan, zc_platform_installers_do_not_require_hand_edited_config. Residual: running install, start, stop, upgrade and local-runtime smoke cases on Linux, m. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_098_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
